title: Judge a claim against applicable observations and uncovered criteria
actor: A reviewer assessing requirement satisfaction or engineering readiness
goal: Determine and record exactly what the available applicable evidence supports and what remains unestablished.
context: An engineering claim has been proposed using observations that may be incomplete, stale, or contradictory.
trigger: The reviewer evaluates the claim before relying on its conclusion.
preconditions: The claim's intended subject state, criterion basis, and scope are identified.

interaction.action: Selects the claim and offered observations and reviews their assessment bases.
Presents evidence applicability, per-criterion support, missing observations, and unresolved material contradictions.
Records the engineering conclusion, reasoning, supported scope, limitations, and disposition of material contradictions.
Presents the judgment with its accountable source and basis, identifying any unsupported satisfaction assertion.

expected_outcome: The recorded conclusion is traceable to applicable evidence and criterion coverage; unsupported scope and unresolved contradictions remain visible rather than becoming a blanket passing judgment.

alternatives.condition: Every included criterion has applicable support and material contradictions are resolved with recorded reasoning.
alternatives.outcome: The reviewer can record a supported conclusion for the declared scope.

alternatives.condition: Only a narrower portion of the proposed claim is supported.
alternatives.outcome: The judgment names that narrower scope and leaves the remaining portion unestablished.

alternatives.condition: A material contrary observation remains unresolved.
alternatives.outcome: The affected claim remains unestablished even when other observations are favorable.

alternatives.condition: A project decision owner accepts a tradeoff or exception.
alternatives.outcome: That decision remains distinct from observed requirement satisfaction and from any separate execution authorization.

alternatives.condition: A proposed favorable conclusion conceals an uncovered criterion or unresolved material contradiction.
alternatives.outcome: The system identifies the inconsistency and retains the affected claim as unestablished.

alternatives.condition: Applicable observations do not cover part of the declared criteria.
alternatives.outcome: The assessment identifies that scope as unestablished with the missing support explicit; recognizing the gap is a valid assessment outcome.

failures.condition: The accountable judging participant or reasoning required to record the proposed judgment is unavailable.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the incomplete judgment basis and does not fabricate an accountable engineering conclusion.

sources.basis: IR-004 owns claim assessment under SR-027 and SR-028. Cross-IR SR-007 keeps conclusions and accepted tradeoffs separate from execution authorization. Accepted as current requirement-analysis knowledge after independent coverage and clarity review: one owning IR and primary Feature, observable goal and interactions, classified outcomes, and applicable SR coverage. This confirms analysis only, not requirement approval, implementation, or satisfaction.
